name: What is the difference between siding sealing and siding painting?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between siding sealing and siding painting?

acceptedAnswer.text: Siding sealing and siding painting serve different primary purposes, though both contribute to exterior protection. Painting focuses on aesthetics and providing a surface-level protective coating against weathering and UV rays. Sealing, however, specifically targets gaps, cracks, and joints in the siding itself to create a watertight and airtight barrier. While some paints have sealing properties, dedicated sealants offer superior flexibility and gap-filling capabilities essential for preventing moisture intrusion and improving energy efficiency at the structural level. Often, both are done for comprehensive protection.
acceptedAnswer.description: Painting focuses on aesthetics and surface protection, while sealing specifically fills gaps and cracks for a watertight, airtight barrier.
